garments.tagline: Festival to office, the whole family dressed
garments.about: We are a family clothing showroom in the main market, stocking sarees, suits, lehengas, kurtas, shirts, kidswear and school uniforms under one roof. Families come to us for the wedding trousseau, the Diwali outfit and the Monday office shirt alike, because the sizes run from a 2-year-old to XXXL and every price is fixed and printed on the tag. Our tailor sits inside the shop, so fall-pico, blouse stitching and alteration are done here and ready before your function. Try it in the trial room, exchange easily with the bill, or ask for photos of new arrivals on WhatsApp and reserve your piece before it is gone.

reviews.name: Ritu S., bride
reviews.text: Bought my wedding lehenga and the whole family's sangeet outfits here in one afternoon. The blouse was stitched to measurement and the second fitting fixed the sleeve exactly like I wanted. Delivered 4 days before the wedding as promised.

reviews.text: They came to our school with a measuring tape, took sizes for 180 students and delivered the uniform sets in two weeks. Colour matched our old uniform perfectly and the parents liked the price.

reviews.text: I pick up cotton kurta sets here every month for office. Sizes are consistent, the pockets are a big plus, and when a palazzo was too long they shortened it the same evening at no charge.

faq.q: Do you have a trial room, and can I bring family along?
faq.a: Yes, two trial rooms with proper mirrors and seating outside for family. For wedding shopping, message us a day before and we keep the sets ready in your sizes.

faq.q: How long does alteration or blouse stitching take?
faq.a: Simple length or waist alteration is ready in 2 to 3 days; a blouse stitched to measurement takes 5 to 7 days. Tell us your function date at billing and we prioritise it, including same-day for urgent cases.

faq.q: What is the exchange policy?
faq.a: Exchange within 7 days with the bill and tags intact, for size or colour. Altered, stitched or sale items are not exchanged, which is why we do the trial before you leave.

faq.q: Can I order uniforms for a school or my staff?
faq.a: Yes. Send us the school or company name, the pattern or a sample, and the number of students or staff. For 25+ sets we give bulk pricing and can come to measure sizes on site.

faq.q: Can I see new arrivals and reserve on WhatsApp?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us the item, occasion, size and budget, and we send photos and a short video. Reserve with a ₹500 advance by UPI; it is adjusted in the bill or refunded if you do not like the piece at trial.

faq.q: Do you keep plus sizes and petite sizes?
faq.a: Women's wear runs from XS to 4XL and men's from 36 to 46 chest in regular stock; larger sizes are arranged within a week. Kids' wear is by age and height from 1 to 14 years.

jewellery.tagline: Hallmarked gold, weighed in front of you
jewellery.about: We are a family-run jewellery showroom in the main market, selling BIS-hallmarked gold, sterling silver and certified diamond jewellery for over two generations. Brides come to us for the full wedding set, parents for the baby's first nazariya, and families for the Dhanteras coin and the silver puja thali, because every piece is weighed on a certified scale in front of you and the bill shows the day's rate, net weight and making charges separately. Our karigars work in the workshop behind the counter, so a custom design from a photo, a resize or a polish is done here and not sent to another city. Visit the showroom or send us a photo on WhatsApp, and we will tell you the weight, the price at today's rate and the date it will be ready.

offer.text: Zero making charges on gold coins and flat 20% off making charges on all gold jewellery booked between Dhanteras and Bhai Dooj; show this page at the counter.

reviews.name: Priyanka S., bride
reviews.text: My bridal set was made from a photo I sent on WhatsApp. They fixed the weight with us before starting and the final bill matched exactly. The set was ready ten days before the wedding, and they adjusted the nath size on the spot.

reviews.name: Mahesh Ji, retired teacher
reviews.text: Exchanged my late mother's old bangles for a chain for my son. They tested and weighed everything in front of me and explained the deduction for stones clearly. Honest dealing, which is rare.

reviews.name: Neha and Rohit, engagement
reviews.text: Bought our solitaire ring here. The diamond certificate was given with the bill and they resized Rohit's ring free the next week. The buy-back policy is written on the bill, not just spoken.

faq.q: Is all your gold BIS hallmarked?
faq.a: Yes. Every gold piece carries the BIS hallmark and a 6-digit HUID, and the HUID and purity (22K or 18K) are printed on your bill so you can verify it on the BIS Care app.

faq.q: How is the price of a piece worked out?
faq.a: Net gold weight multiplied by the day's rate, plus making charges per gram (shown on the tag), plus 3% GST. Stones are weighed and billed separately. Nothing is added that is not on the bill.

faq.q: Do you buy or exchange old gold?
faq.a: Yes. Old gold is tested on our XRF machine and weighed in front of you. Against a new purchase we adjust it at the day's rate; for cash sale a small deduction applies and it is told to you before the test.

faq.q: Can you make a design I saw online?
faq.a: Send the photo on WhatsApp. We confirm the approximate weight, the making charges and the ready date, and begin after a 25% advance. Simple pieces take about 2 weeks, bridal sets 4 to 6 weeks.

faq.q: What if a stone falls or a chain breaks later?
faq.a: Bring it in. Cleaning and polishing is free for life on pieces bought here, stones and clasps are refitted at the cost of the part only, and we repair jewellery bought elsewhere too at a fixed charge.

faq.q: How can I pay, and is EMI available?
faq.a: UPI, debit and credit cards, bank transfer and cash within the legal limit. Card EMI of 3 to 12 months is available on diamond and bridal jewellery. Our 11-month gold savings scheme is another way to plan a big purchase.

kirana.tagline: Your month's ration, packed fresh, delivered home
kirana.about: We are a family-run kirana store on Station Road, serving the homes, hostels and small canteens of our neighbourhood since the days when atta still came in paper bags. From chakki atta, dal and khula masala weighed in front of you to branded oil, dairy, biscuits and household cleaning, we keep everything a kitchen runs on under one roof. Every packet is date-checked before it goes into your bag, every item is billed at printed MRP or lower, and a WhatsApp list in the morning reaches your door by evening. Walk in, call, or send a photo of your list — we know most of our customers' monthly orders by heart.

reviews.name: Sunita M., homemaker
reviews.text: I send a photo of my handwritten list on the 1st of every month and it arrives by evening, packed exactly as written. Last month they called to say the ghee I wanted was out of stock and suggested another brand instead of just skipping it. That is the difference from an app.

reviews.text: They supply atta, rice and oil for our 60-bed boys' hostel every Monday without fail. The bags are weighed in front of our cook and we get one clean bill at month end, which makes the accounts easy.

reviews.text: The milk, bread and egg pack at 7 am has removed one daily headache. We paused it for a week's holiday with one message and the bill adjusted itself. Would love if curd was added by default too.

faq.q: Do you deliver at home, and is there a minimum order?
faq.a: Yes. Delivery is free within 2 km for orders above ₹300; smaller orders and farther areas carry a ₹30 – ₹50 charge, which we tell you before packing. Lists sent before 1 pm go out the same evening between 5 and 8 pm.

faq.q: Can I order my whole month's ration in one go?
faq.a: Yes, that is what most of our regular customers do. Send your list once on WhatsApp or hand it over at the counter; we save it, pack it on your chosen date every month and send a reminder two days before so you can add or remove items.

faq.q: Do you sell loose (khula) items or only packets?
faq.a: Both. Atta, rice, dal, sugar, poha, besan and whole spices are available khula and weighed in front of you from 250 g upwards. Branded packets are also stocked for those who prefer sealed packs.

faq.q: What if something is damaged, expired or the wrong item?
faq.a: Bring it back or show us a photo on WhatsApp with the bill and we replace it on the next delivery, no questions. We check dates on every packet before packing, but if anything slips through it is our mistake, not yours.

faq.q: Do you keep a specific brand I use?
faq.a: We stock the brands people in the area ask for most. If yours is not on the shelf, message us the name and pack size; we usually get it from the distributor within 2 – 3 days and keep it stocked once you order it regularly.

faq.q: How can I pay?
faq.a: Cash, UPI and cards at the counter. For WhatsApp orders and deliveries we send a UPI payment link or you pay the delivery boy by UPI or cash. Regular customers can run a monthly khata settled on the 1st.

faq.q: Is the phone sealed and does it come with a GST bill?
faq.a: Yes. Every phone is a sealed box opened in front of you, with a GST bill in your name and the brand's warranty card. We also note the IMEI on the bill for warranty claims.

faq.q: Can I buy on EMI without a credit card?
faq.a: Yes. Besides credit and debit card EMI, we do zero-down-payment finance through a finance company for phones and TVs above ₹8,000. Bring Aadhaar, PAN and a bank passbook or statement; approval usually takes 15 to 20 minutes at the counter.

faq.q: How much will I get for my old phone in exchange?
faq.a: It depends on the model, age and condition. Bring the phone to the shop, or send photos and the model name on WhatsApp for a rough value; the final price is given after we test the screen, battery and camera in front of you.

faq.q: How long does a screen or battery replacement take and is it original?
faq.a: Most screens and batteries are done the same day, usually in 1 to 2 hours if the part is in stock. We offer both original company parts and good-quality compatible parts and tell you the price difference clearly before starting.

faq.q: Will you transfer my contacts, photos and WhatsApp to the new phone?
faq.a: Yes, free with every phone. Contacts, photos, videos, WhatsApp chats and apps are moved, your Google account and bank apps are set up, and the tempered glass and cover are fitted before you leave.

faq.q: Do you deliver and install TVs at home?
faq.a: Yes. TVs are delivered and wall-mounted free inside the city within 48 hours. For nearby villages and towns, delivery charges depend on the distance; message us the location and we will tell you.
